title: NIST WebBook: Sulfuric Acid is H2O4S, molecular weight 98.078 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Sulfuric Acid as H2O4S, molecular weight 98.078 amu, CAS 7664-93-9.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Sulfuric Acid, CAS Registry Number 7664-93-9, lists molecular formula H2O4S and molecular weight 98.078 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 97.96737954 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/H2O4S/c1-5(2,3)4/h(H2,1,2,3,4). The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight.
